By $D(G)$ we denote the smallest integer $d\\in \\mathbb N$ such that every sequence over $G$ of length at least $d$ contains a nonempty zero-sum subsequence. By $\\eta(G)$ we denote the smallest integer $d\\in \\mathbb N$ such that every sequence over $G$ of length at least $d$ contains a zero-sum subsequence $T$ with length $|T|\\in [1,\\exp(G)]$, such a sequence $T$ will be called a short zero-sum sequence. Let $C_0(G)$ denote the set consists of all integer $t\\in [D(G)+1,\\eta(G)-1]$ such that every zero-sum sequence of length exactly $t$ contains a short zero-sum subsequence. In this paper, we investigate the question whether $C_0(G)\\neq \\emptyset$ for all non-cyclic finite abelian groups $G$. Previous results showed that $C_0(G)\\neq \\emptyset$ for the groups $C_n^2$ ($n\\geq 3$) and $C_3^3$.
